gauge_zero_history.detail: SGB 2022 report states no record was found of a change in the position of the gauge zero (no 100 cm or other offset added historically).
gauge_zero_history.source: SGB Projeto de regionalização de vazões / análise de frequência de cotas, Muçum 86510000 (2022)

ana_inventory_altitude.reason: The field is station inventory metadata; no RN/nivelamento relationship tying this number to gauge zero and the project MDT vertical reference has been recovered.

absolute_rn.required_source: SGB/ANA station descriptive sheet, RN leveling record or equivalent surveyed relationship between gauge zero and a known vertical datum

allowed: Compare SGB LSTs with each other in gauge-relative coordinates.
Use gauge-relative section geometry for shape/depth constraints after numeric vertices are recovered.
Use current Muçum rating curve in gauge-stage coordinates within its documented validity.
forbidden: Do not add 240 m to gauge readings.
Do not subtract MDT elevation from gauge stage before RN/datum reconciliation.
Do not merge flood-mark elevations, MDT terrain and gauge-relative LST as if they shared a vertical datum.
Do not publish HEC-RAS absolute water-surface elevations from the pilot until vertical reference is reconciled.
next_action: Recover numeric vertices of SGB LST 22/07/2022 or original survey file.
Recover RN/nivelamento from SGB/ANA descriptive station records.
Then transform S09 measured section to project vertical datum and splice only bank/floodplain terrain outside the measured channel.
